sloka: द्वारेषु तासाम् चत्वारः सम्क्रमाः परम आयताः ।यन्त्रैर् उपेता बहुभिर् महद्भिर् दृढ सम्धिभिः ॥६-३-१६॥।।
transliteration: dvāreṣu tāsām catvāraḥ samkramāḥ parama āyatāḥ ।yantrair upetā bahubhir mahadbhir dṛḍha samdhibhiḥ ॥6-3-16॥।।

translations.english: At the entrance of the gateways around the moats are four road ways. Huge engines are fixed to move the bridges when people approach. There are rows of houses (for the guards) at the gateways.
